info.name: Sonata API - Route access
info.description: Checks route-based auth on every endpoint (REQ-011.AC10/AC11). Each case creates its own users: read-only and write-only on the route, every other route, and no routes. Path variables use unknown ids, so an allowed call changes nothing; 'let through' means any status but 401/403. When an endpoint is added, add it to its route's case.

item.name: 00 Setup
item.description: Logs in as the bootstrap administrator. run.js runs this before every case.

exec: // 'root' and 'admin' are the same bootstrap administrator.

item.name: RTE-open Open endpoints need no token; /api/users/me needs a token but no route
RTE-open 02 setup: log in as noRoutes

exec: pm.test("refresh works with only a refresh token", () => {
